finding: The FFNN uterine closure technique was associated with a lower incidence of isthmocele formation and greater RMT compared to the SLL technique.
mod_finding: The study compared two different uterine closure techniques used during cesarean sections and found that the double-layer, far-far-near-near (FFNN) unlocked technique was associated with less frequent isthmocele formation and greater residual myometrial thickness compared to the single-layer continuous locked (SLL) technique.
